decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on a well-established and popular trommel platform that fits the core mobile screening business, so it is likely kept despite not appearing on the website in 2020 to 2021.
The mobile flail shredder line fits the core mobile recycling portfolio, but its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 suggests some risk of a portfolio cleanup.
The high-speed grinders broaden the mobile shredding range and serve core customers, though they had low visibility and later disappeared from the website.
This niche stationary electric fine shredder had little visibility and no later website presence, so its resources are better used in the core mobile business.
The green-waste grinder serves established composting customers, but it overlaps with Product C and could be merged into that line.
The stationary pre-shredder line supports the strategy of plant-based and international solutions, so it is likely retained.
